_comment: Demo stand-in for the team pipeline: discovery, scoring and labels normally come from the other FORGE modules. analyze.py turns this list into forge_state.json.

suspects.label: likely_fake
reasons: 5 images copied from the official store (logo and 4 product photos)
Official logo and 'Official Sale' label used
'UPI only' payment; no cards or cash on delivery
No returns; contact by WhatsApp only

suspects.label: suspicious
reasons: 1 near-duplicate image (Summit Shell Jacket, mirrored and recoloured)
Discounts of 33–40%, within a normal outlet range
Lists cards, UPI and cash on delivery

suspects.label: suspicious
reasons: 4 official images used (logo and 3 product photos)
Claims to be a 'Northstar retail partner'; retailer authorization requires confirmation
Physical store address, GST invoices and 7-day returns listed
